questions.question: Moses told Israel that people do not live on bread alone. What did he say they also live on?

answers.text: Every word from the mouth of the LORD
Whatever they can gather each morning
The bread their fathers ate in Egypt

questions.question: In the thirsty and waterless wilderness, where did the LORD bring water for Israel from?
Moses told Israel the LORD gives them the power to gain wealth. Why does He give it?

answers.text: To confirm His covenant with their fathers
To make the nations jealous of Israel
To pay for offerings at the tabernacle

questions.question: What did Moses say would happen to Israel if they forgot the LORD and went after other gods?

answers.text: They would wander forty more years
They would lose half of the land
